messages.subject: ggplot2
parts:
Dear All,

 

I am trying to do a plot with ggplot2 with this statement (qplot(d$ageb,d$hwt, geom = c("smooth", "point"), method="lm", shape=d$apond), but getting the following error:

 

Error: scale_shape_discrete can deal with a maximum of 6 discrete values, but you have 13.

 

Any help appreciated

 

Alex

messages.author: 20dc65e0eb086831
